goal: Move UI string formatting and translation for fatal and flush errors out of libbitcoinkernel into the node layer
Replace string-based error notifications with typed errors across the kernel boundary
agreement: Concept approval without detailed review (sedited, yuvicc)
Unaddressed objection: numeric error codes in C API callbacks lose details needed to reconstruct causes (yuvicc)
Answered objection without follow-up: C API callbacks lose details for kernel applications (ryanofsky)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it strips application-level translation machinery out of libbitcoinkernel
Directly advances decoupling node dependencies from the kernel library
